selected.title: Raft Protocol for Fault Tolerance and Self-Recovery in Federated Learning
selected.venue: 2024 IEEE/ACM 19th Symposium on Software Engineering for Adaptive and Self-Managing Systems (SEAMS)

pdfFindings.testbed: 11 Raspberry Pi 3, wireless LAN, Flower + PySyncObj, CNN on CIFAR-10, ~250 kB updates, 1 FL round for traffic
notes: Text says the traffic overhead is 'approx. 5 times'; this holds only at 9-10 workers (1.81x at 1 worker).
Text says re-election time 'grows slightly'; it rises 2.96x from 1 to 10 workers.
Section 6.2.1 says 2 to 10 workers were launched, but Fig. 3 also plots 1 worker; standard Raft cannot elect a leader with 1 of 2 nodes left. Not explained in the paper.
Fig. 4 caption does not state whether the red bars are total traffic or port 5000 only.

selected.title: A Performance Analysis for Confidential Federated Learning

notes: Abstract says overhead is at most 2x; Table 3 shows 2.20x for ResNet-18 on CIFAR-100.
'About 2.7x' and 'about 5.9x' in Section 5.1 are ratios of coefficients between the two models, not slowdowns.
